_help: Each key inside 'eyes' is an item id. Rename '_endrem:old_eye' to 'endrem:old_eye' to enable the example.
remove_defaults: true strips the item from EVERY loot table and mob drop, so only the sources below give it.
remove_from: strip it only from these loot tables, structures (chests inside them) or mobs.
loot_tables: add it to these loot tables (chests, mobs, anything). Find ids with /eyeconfig tables <filter>.
structures: add it to every chest opened inside these structures. Stand in one and run /eyeconfig here.
mobs: add it to the drops of these entities (works for modded bosses without a loot table).
Entries are an id string (100%) or { id, chance (0-1 or 0-100), count (n or [min,max]), require_player }.
Ids starting with '#' are tags. Apply changes with /eyeconfig reload, test chests with /eyeconfig simulate.
debug: true logs every item the mod adds, handy to check your rules in game.
